author: Jodie Sugg
citation: Stayed here for 1 night and was a LUSH location! The road was quiet throughout the night and could hear the waves. Toilets available on the beach.
location: Sandy Bay Carpark, overnight campervan parking, near Sandy Bay beach, Whangarei, Northland, New Zealand
provenance: Personal review by Jodie Sugg on Rankers, January 2025, describing a night spent in the designated overnight carpark at Sandy Bay, hearing the waves, with toilets on the beach.

author: Chappy Mike
citation: What a site. 150 yards to the water. Listening to the waves crash all night is worth the drive to the coast. Bathroom tidy.
location: Sandy Bay Carpark, overnight campervan parking, near Sandy Bay beach, Whangarei, Northland, New Zealand
provenance: Personal review by Chappy Mike on Rankers, October 2022, recounting a night in the carpark 150 yards from the water at Sandy Bay, listening to the waves.
